title: Speed up --files iteration by scoping analysis inputs

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Investigating current --files behavior. Goal: add an opt-in mode that limits CodeQL analysis scope to specific files for faster local iteration while preserving existing output-filter behavior.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Implemented file-scoped scan mode with new --scan-files flag. Behavior: resolve literal/glob patterns under repo root, copy only matches into a temporary source root, detect languages from that scoped root, and run CodeQL against it. Added guardrails: reject --scan-files with --report-only, and fail fast when no files match. Added docs and tests in tests/test_scan_scope.py and tests/test_cli.py, plus BDD feature/steps for scan-scope behavior. Validation run in this environment: poetry run pytest tests/test_scan_scope.py tests/test_cli.py -q => 18 passed; poetry run ruff check on touched Python files => clean. Note: pytest-bdd is not installed in this environment, so BDD step collection currently errors until that dependency is available.
